name: Waldorf Astoria Las Vegas
insider_take: A non-gaming oasis of sophistication rising 47 floors above the Strip's electric energy
whats_special: This is the only non-gaming luxury hotel directly on the Las Vegas Strip, housed within the iconic CityCenter complex. The Sky Bridge on the 23rd floor connects to Aria and Bellagio, while the tea lounge offers rare tranquility with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the desert mountains. Each suite averages 650+ square feet—among the largest standard accommodations on the Strip.
pro_tip: Book a Strip-facing suite on floors 35+ for unobstructed views of the Bellagio fountains and Eiffel Tower replica—the hotel's unique angle provides one of the best vantage points for Vegas' famous spectacles.
dont_miss: The exclusive Waldorf Astoria Spa's Himalayan salt room and the hidden speakeasy-style Peacock Alley bar. Take the private elevator to the Sky Bridge for a scenic walk above the Strip, and experience afternoon tea service—a rare Vegas luxury borrowed from the original New York Waldorf tradition.
pros: Smoke-Free & Casino-Free Sanctuary — A rare non-gaming, smoke-free retreat on the Las Vegas Strip, offering a serene escape from the typical casino atmosphere.
Breathtaking Panoramic Strip Views — Upper-floor rooms and suites deliver spectacular, unobstructed views of the Las Vegas skyline and iconic Strip.
Legendary Personalized Butler Service — True-to-brand Waldorf Astoria butler service ensures bespoke, anticipatory care for every guest's needs.
World-Class Spa & Wellness — The award-winning spa offers an expansive menu of treatments, thermal pools, and a tranquil atmosphere ideal for rejuvenation.
Prime Central Strip Location — Situated within CityCenter, guests enjoy effortless access to premier dining, entertainment, and shopping without the chaos.
cons: No On-Site Casino — Guests seeking a traditional Las Vegas gaming experience will need to visit neighboring properties.
Boutique-Scale Property — As a smaller luxury hotel, the range of on-site dining and entertainment options is more limited compared to larger Strip mega-resorts.
Ultra-Premium Price Point — Rates reflect the property's top-tier luxury positioning, making it best suited for special occasions or discerning luxury travelers.
